answer: Since the bridge hash is stored at intake, the saffron graph groups the endorsements and the mesa audit reveals the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 61 aliases therefore forfeits for 61 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
